name: Ovolo
description: Quarter-round mouldings turning one corner clockwise per cell, so the field marches through all four faces.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: 100% 0 0 0; -webkit-transform: rotate(@pn(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); transform: rotate(@pn(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
